name: @bye/mobile
description: bye for iOS and Android (React Native). Installed with npm, outside the pnpm workspace.

scripts.ios:project: cd ios && xcodegen generate && pod install
scripts.ios:build-sim: xcodebuild -workspace ios/ByeMobile.xcworkspace -scheme ByeMobile -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive: xcodebuild -workspace ios/ByeMobile.xcworkspace -scheme ByeMobile -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/ByeMobile.xcarchive CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=${BYE_BUILD_NUMBER:-1} archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/ByeMobile.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build/ipa
